// diagnostic

L0517

A typed normalized Path is checked with a string prefix

What

A typed normalized Path is checked with a string prefix

Why

Path.is_within() owns separator-aware lexical containment; converting both paths to strings repeats that policy

Fix

Replace the string comparison with Path.is_within()

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning L0517: tests/ui_lint/path_containment_string_prefix.warn.

Warning [L0517] (path_containment_string_prefix): A typed normalized Path is checked with a string prefix
  --> tests/ui_lint/path_containment_string_prefix.jet:22:8
    |
 22 |     if candidate != base && !candidate.starts_with("{base}/") {
    |        ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: Path.is_within() owns separator-aware lexical containment; converting both paths to strings repeats that policy
 Fix: Replace the string comparison with Path.is_within()
